scope: Ad Astra1.16.26 station payment and accepted placement adapter source review

source_facts.fact: matches independently sums every inventory stack for each IngredientHolder, allowing the same capacity to satisfy overlapping demands more than once.
consumeIngredients removes holder.count only from the first matching slot and breaks. A64 demand from1+63 removes1, while matches succeeds.

Exact Type.handle returns Consumer<Player>; native consumer checks target orbit/menu/native rocket readiness/Cadmus/recipe/nearby station, then hasIngredients and consumeIngredients, then structure ticket/place, registration, spawn location, teleport and claims. Placement boolean is discarded.
canConstruct calls hasIngredients for UI outside a construction scope. This query must not be mistaken for an actual paid manufacturing attempt.

constructSpaceStation adds a SpaceStation at the captured player chunk to a UUID-keyed existing SavedData map; no proof/cost checks inside. isInSpaceStation denies chessboard distance<=2 from any station.
canTeleportToPlanet first requires PlanetsMenu; Creative/Spectator/operator bypass rocket and disabled-planet conditions. Survival requires Rocket above atmosphereLeave and tier>=targetPlanet tier.
This pin has commented Cadmus claim implementation and isClaimed returns true. Preserve native early denial if Cadmus is installed; no working external claims integration is proven.
Native placeInWorld success does not certify accepted primary writes or a complete final structure; palette/entity/size validity alone can reach true.
Actual compiled placeInWorld has three ServerLevelAccessor.setBlock(BlockPos,BlockState,int)boolean invokes at330,343,1057; primary requested block placement is ordinal1 at343.
Six station recipes have floor0 in baseline, while six destination orbit floors are37/38. Existing travel event stage checks occur after station placement; add explicit early stage enforcement.

stable_hooks.purpose: Wrap actual returned consumer in one-shot try/finally context; do not guess synthetic lambda name or match bridge overload.

implementation_guidance: Global capacity allocation is required to avoid duplicate use and greedy false negatives; inputs must remain current by refs/count/components and current tag definition.
Bound player inventory/demands and ingredient semantics before any native input writes; reject unknown/custom semantics without manufacturing proof.
Use existing synchronizedPlayerTeam and explicit destination floor37/38 before payment or placement; an after-the-fact teleport cancellation is too late.
Capture existing template by get(id), bound private list counts and dimensions before cloning/serialization; native station needs30752 block entries, not a16384 bound.
A strict single-palette, no-entity, null-block-NBT contract supports the bundled native template without arbitrary deep NBT serialization.
Accepted primary nonair writes plus a retained definition can prove an accepted structure operation; do not call this universal complete construction or transactional rollback.
If payment precedes placement, rejection can retain native costs/effects. Never invent automatic refund/output/rollback.
Existing station SavedData should remain untouched; no adoption/reset migration is needed for an additive guard.
